scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,web,scheduler" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:scheduler"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@schedulai/shared-types run build && npm --workspace=@schedulai/config run build && npm --workspace=@schedulai/validation run build
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:scheduler
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm --workspace=@schedulai/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@schedulai/web run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm --workspace=@schedulai/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace=@schedulai/config run typecheck && npm --workspace=@schedulai/validation run typecheck
